import_provenance.original_statement: Can the threshold winning probability in finite turn-based stochastic parity games be computed in polynomial time, with both the number of priorities and binary-encoded rational probabilities unrestricted? This is the quantitative verification problem studied directly by Henzinger, Chatterjee and Jurdziński, combining adversarial control, randomness and infinite-run specifications.
